author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-15 06:33: "Talk to someone, there cargo was taken, get it back from dungeon and deliver ig"
_note: THE HIJACKED RUN: you meet a hauler first, raiders took her cargo into a dungeon, you take it back and FINISH HER
RUN, delivering it where it was going rather than back to her. That is his Delve shape exactly: an unfinished job
somebody else started (2026-09-23). His idea; words Jessica's.
A PURE VARIANT by his rule (prove the verbs, then vary cheaply): talk first is 14a's, recover off the dungeon boss
is 11a's, the delivery is 14a's, three places is 08a's. If the lint passes, nothing here is new machinery.
Order: talk at the main place (quiet, peopled by her), the dungeon second, the drop third. Three disjoint pools as
08a, so no two beats can share a site.
Pay: reward on the delivery, the single ending. 'hard' is a placeholder; the tier is his.

place._themes: THREE DISJOINT POOLS, as 08a: her out in the wild by her landed ship (natural, not a quiet site), the raiders at a built hostile site (no natural, no quiet), the drop at a quiet built site, where people are waiting. Quiet AND natural is an empty pool (measured 2026-10-15), so the wild end is hers.

prose.name: Recovery: Hijacked Filters on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A hauler set down near the <Place> was jumped on her run. The raiders left her the ship and took the cargo, a crate of water filters somebody is waiting for.

beats.objective: Talk to the hauler at the <Place>
beats.journal: Raiders jumped a hauler and took her cargo, a crate of water filters, to the <SecondPlace>. She asked me to finish her run and take them to the <ThirdPlace>.

person.name: Rhea Dunmore
hellos: Easy. I've had enough visitors this week.

greeting: You're not one of them, are you? Good. Then you can help, if you want to.

reply: Somebody's been waiting a week to drink without boiling it first.
Don't bring it back to me. Take it where it was going.
Four of them. Very polite until they weren't.
They took the crate and left me the ship, which I suppose was kind of them.
I did. Someone's going to look into it next month. The filters were due last week.
Tall. A scar through one eyebrow. Laughed at his own jokes.
If he's worth something to you, take that as well. I won't miss him.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 closes the talk and sets the recover's stage. Exchange 3 is a [Bounty Hunter] line (his 2026-10-14 RP feature): only a hunter asks for a description. Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

beats.objective: Recover the filter crate from the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: The raiders' leader at the <SecondPlace> had the crate of water filters. I took it back. It still needs to reach the <ThirdPlace>.

beats.objective: Deliver the water filters to the <ThirdPlace>
beats.journal: A hauler was jumped on her run and lost a crate of water filters to raiders at the <SecondPlace>. I got them back and finished the run to the <ThirdPlace>.
beats.name: Supply Drop Locker

message.title: Delivered
message.text: The crate goes into the locker. Somebody has taped a note inside the lid: FILTERS?? with three question marks.

broadcast: I'm fine, the ship's fine. The cargo isn't, and somebody's waiting on it.
_speech: Her voice on the radio first, then in person. Voice is 05a's (wCizWKvnaS3LOIUwHo98), used once so far, so this is not Isla; his ear decides. No names, no places, no currency.
